info.name: The Merchant Engine API
info.description: Every storefront and admin route of the engine, generated from the two OpenAPI documents. Authentication is a session cookie: run Storefront > Authentication > Sign in once and the cookie jar sends it on every request after. Set baseUrl and locale in the environment.

item.name: Storefront
item.description: Customer and anonymous routes. Every request sends Accept-Language; a customer route needs the session cookie Sign in sets.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: These four requests come from the authentication handler (Better Auth, mounted at /v1/auth) and not from the OpenAPI document. Sign in sets the session cookie and the cookie jar sends it on every later request; the admin signs in through the same handler with a staff account.
